pages.markdown: # Findings from the Northern Camp Field notes from that expedition remain the only record of the northern camp. The museum extended its hours to accommodate the unexpected crowds. An old map showed a road that no longer appears in any modern atlas. After the storm the harbor was calm enough for the ferries to resume service. ## Background The kitchen staff prepared meals for three hundred guests without a single delay. After the storm the harbor was calm enough for the ferries to resume service. They repaired the roof in the afternoon and finished the gutters before dark. - Rotate the sampling sites so no single plot is overused. - Store the photographs with their original labels attached. - Back up the field notes to the shared archive every evening. - Publish the revised schedule on the notice board each Monday. - Check the calibration log before the first run of the day. ## Scope of the Study Nobody expected the small town to host a festival of that size. Local farmers report that the soil has improved since they adopted cover crops. Students designed a weather station using parts they found in the workshop.
